---

Preconditions:

- [ ] I have made sure it's an actual issue, not a question (use [GitHub Discussions](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) instead).
- [ ] I have consulted the [user guide](../../docs/02-usage/000_intro.md) and verified that the issue cannot be resolved by adjusting configuration/following recommended workflows.
- [ ] I have looked for similar issues and discussions, including closed ones.

Issue details:

- [ ] I have provided a meaningful title and description.
- [ ] I have explained how the issue arose and, where possible, added instructions on how to reproduce it.
- [ ] I have added details on my setup: Selene version, MCP client, OS, the programming language(s), relevant configuration adjustments and project specifics.
- [ ] If the issue relates to an application of Selene to an open-source project, I have added the link.
